## ACTOR_DEFAULT_LIGHT_WGSL
const ACTOR_DEFAULT_LIGHT_WGSL = "\nfn actor_light(actor: u32, world: vec3f, normal: vec3f, color: vec3f, light: u32) -> vec3f {\n  let key = normalize(vec3f(0.4, 0.8, 0.3));\n  return color * unpack4x8unorm(light).rgb * (0.45 + 0.55 * max(dot(normal, key), 0.0));\n}\n";

}

}
